criteria.label: Cover appeal
criteria.description: The dedicated portrait cover has a clear focal point, readable title treatment, and premium shelf appeal.

criteria.label: 1.62:1 stage composition
criteria.description: Each spread reads as one intentional composition on the approximately 1.62:1 stage across the gutter without accidental dead zones or collisions.

criteria.label: Text safety and readability
criteria.description: Titles and copy remain inside safe zones with sufficient contrast, spacing, and readable line lengths.

criteria.label: Visual and character consistency
criteria.description: Style, palette, recurring characters, proportions, and defining details stay coherent across the whole book.

criteria.label: Personal-photo fidelity
criteria.description: People remain recognisable and source-true, while personal photos feel naturally integrated under the agreed photo policy.

criteria.label: Crop, skew, occlusion, and scale
criteria.description: Images avoid accidental crop, skew, obstruction, stretched anatomy, and implausible relative scale.

criteria.label: Missing or fallback assets
criteria.description: The cover and every spread use their intended final assets; no blank, placeholder, or fallback plate remains.

criteria.label: Transparent edges and matte
criteria.description: Foreground subjects have true transparent edges without rectangles, baked checkerboards, halos, or chroma spill.

criteria.label: Layered spread contract
criteria.description: Every spread has one complete generated clean plate or preserved-photo final base and two to four non-procedural foreground or interactive layers.

criteria.label: Creation asset policy
criteria.description: Every spread follows the ready brief's generated or preserved-photo policy, and personal source assets remain in their declared role.

criteria.label: Story or album coherence
criteria.description: The sequence has an intelligible opening, development, turn, and ending, or a clear keepsake chronology.

criteria.label: Meaningful interaction
criteria.description: Every spread includes an interaction that adds story, knowledge, or delight instead of decorative motion alone.

criteria.label: Premium sample value
criteria.description: The finished book is credible beside The Starlight Stitch and The Blue Road Home as a promotional sample.

criteria.label: Render evidence completeness
criteria.description: The current revision has real rendered evidence for the cover and every spread before visual critique.
